name: Mont Belvieu Crossing
summary: Mont Belvieu Crossing is a 300,000+ square foot community shopping center located at the I-10 and Eagle Drive interchange in Mont Belvieu, Texas. Managed by FRP Ltd., this modern retail destination serves the rapidly growing East Houston market with convenient access and diverse retail opportunities.
demographics: Mont Belvieu Crossing serves a growing suburban and exurban market in the Houston metropolitan area, primarily attracting middle-income families and petrochemical industry workers employed in the nearby industrial corridor. The trade area draws from Mont Belvieu's rapidly expanding residential communities, with households typically consisting of young families with children and dual-income earners. Shoppers in this market prioritize convenience and value, seeking everyday necessities and family-oriented retail options close to home. The center benefits from its strategic location at I-10 and Eagle Drive, capturing both local residents and pass-through traffic from the broader East Houston region.
description: Mont Belvieu Crossing is a thriving community shopping center strategically positioned at the northwest corner of Interstate 10 and Eagle Drive in Mont Belvieu, Texas. Developed and managed by FRP Ltd., this modern retail destination offers over 300,000 square feet of retail opportunities designed to serve the rapidly growing communities of East Houston. The center's prime location provides exceptional visibility and accessibility along one of Texas's major transportation corridors, making it a convenient stop for both local residents and travelers. With its thoughtfully planned layout and diverse tenant mix, Mont Belvieu Crossing has established itself as the premier shopping destination in this expanding market, catering to the everyday needs of families and professionals working in the nearby petrochemical industry. The property's strong performance is reflected in its 4.5-star rating from nearly 200 reviews, demonstrating its popularity among shoppers who appreciate the center's accessibility, tenant variety, and modern amenities.
